title: 第一卷 第7章 被轻薄的太子爷-《我养的AI竟是京圈太子爷》
content:
第(1/3)页

    溪山。

    霖多多盯着自己的掌心，回味着刚才的触感，忍不住小声嘀咕：“手感不要太好诶……简直就是个超大号捏捏乐！软硬适中，回弹快速，啥材质做的啊？”

    捏完之后，见上官程仍然没有反应，霖多多不由蹙起了眉头：“就剩最后一个地方了，如果真是那里就....”她咬了咬唇，“就算了！”

    她实在下不去手。

    “唉——开不了机，那你就真成一坨金属疙瘩了。但也不能把你单独扔这儿啊，万一被虫爬了，豹子挠了，落上鸟粑粑了，你醒来会哭的吧？”

    “啧，麻烦。”

    霖多多一边无奈的吐槽，一边想法子把人拖回去。就在此时，她忽然听到上官程体内传出细微的电流声——嗡嗡嗡，像是什么东西重新启动了。

    “开机键还真在这种地方啊！”

    她惊喜不已，但立刻又想到了什么，开始手忙脚乱地帮对方穿衣服。

    “这机器人自尊心强，爱害羞。帮它解个扣子都不肯，要是让它知道我差点给它扒光了……它不得羞愤自爆啊？”

    她越想越心虚，手上动作加快了几分。最后一颗扣子刚系好，上官程的眼睛便睁开了。

    那双桃花眼直直地盯着她，目光里是浓浓的幽怨。

    像是一个被轻薄了的大家闺秀，羞愤欲死却又难以启齿，颇有股与人同归于尽的怨怼。

    霖多多被这眼神盯得连说话都不利索了：“开、开机了啊……那咱继续赶路吧，争取天黑前到。”

    她说着转身就要走。

    背包却被男人从身后扯住，稳稳地把她钉在了原地。

    “刚刚发生了什么。”上官程站了起来，声音冰凉，一字一句像从牙缝里挤出来的，“主人不要解释一下吗？”做了龌龊事却不想认，哪有这么便宜的事？他必要她付出代价！

    他居高临下地看着她，身后的某处还残留着隐隐的钝痛，提醒着他刚才发生的一切。

    “趁我出bug死机，您对我，做了什么？”

    霖多多心慌了一瞬，装傻充愣：“我、我能对你做什么啊？说得我好似干了什么见不得人的事似的。你可别冤枉人啊，我对一块金属疙瘩可没有任何非分之想！”

    “还隐瞒不说？”上官程逼近一步，声音更冷了几分，那双桃花眼里幽怨与审视交织，“是怕我生气不再听令，无法帮你找到矿石？还是怕我情绪失控整体报废，让你损失一件昂贵的资产？”

    “我……不是的，我没有那样想……”她被逼问得越发慌乱起来，眼神躲闪，一时不知该如何解释，“我就是帮你检查了一下故障，什么都没干！”

Page (1/3)

Xishan.

Lin Duoduo stared at the palm of his hand, recalling the touch just now, and couldn't help but murmur in a low voice: "Don't feel too good...it's just an oversized pincher! It has moderate softness and hardness, and quick rebound. What material is it made of?"

After squeezing, Lin Duoduo couldn't help but frowned when she saw that Shangguan Cheng still didn't respond: "There's only one last place left. If it's really there..." She bit her lip, "Forget it!"

She really couldn't do it.

"Oh - if you can't turn on the phone, then you will really be a metal lump. But I can't leave you here alone. If you are crawled by an insect, scratched by a leopard, or a bird falls on you, you will cry when you wake up, right?"

"Tsk, trouble."

Lin Duoduo complained helplessly while thinking of ways to drag the person back.At this moment, she suddenly heard a subtle electric sound coming from Shangguan Cheng's body - buzzing, as if something was restarting.

“The power button is really in a place like this!”

She was pleasantly surprised, but she immediately thought of something and started to help the other party get dressed.

"This robot has a strong self-esteem and is very shy. It won't even unbutton a button for it. If it knew that I almost stripped it naked... wouldn't it explode in shame and anger?"

The more she thought about it, the more she felt guilty, and her hand movements sped up a bit.As soon as the last button was fastened, Shangguan Cheng's eyes opened.

Those peach blossom eyes stared straight at her, with deep resentment in their eyes.

Like a lady who has been scorned, she is so ashamed and angry that she cannot speak out, and she has a resentment that she will die with others.

Lin Duoduo was so stared at that he couldn't even speak: "It's on, it's on... Let's keep on going and try to get there before dark."

She said and turned to leave.

However, the man grabbed her backpack from behind and pinned her firmly to the spot.

"What just happened." Shangguan Cheng stood up, his voice was cold, and every word seemed to be squeezed out from between his teeth, "Master, don't you want to explain it?" He did something dirty but didn't want to admit it. How could it be so cheap?He needs her to pay the price!

He looked down at her, and there was still a dull pain somewhere behind him, reminding him of what had just happened.

"What did you do to me when I crashed due to a bug?"

Lin Duoduo was flustered for a moment and pretended to be dumbfounded: "What, what can I do to you? It sounds like I did something shameful. Don't accuse me unfairly, I don't have any wrong thoughts about a piece of metal!"

"Are you still hiding it?" Shangguan Cheng took a step closer, his voice a little colder, and the resentment and scrutiny in his peach blossom eyes were intertwined, "Are you afraid that I will get angry and stop obeying orders, and will not be able to help you find the ore? Or are you afraid that I will lose control of my emotions and scrap the whole thing, causing you to lose an expensive asset?"

"I...no, I didn't think so..." She became more and more panicked when she was pressed, her eyes evaded, and she didn't know how to explain, "I just checked the fault for you, and I didn't do anything!"
